label: gym_kusa_040_receptionist_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Artazon Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].

label: gym_kusa_040_receptionist_01
text: Are you ready to challenge Gym Leader Brassius,\nthe Verdant Virtuoso?

label: gym_kusa_040_receptionist_02
text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.

label: gym_kusa_040_receptionist_03
text: Of course. Please feel free to come speak to me\nwhenever you’re ready.

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_entry_01
text: Greetings, challenger![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_entry_02
text: Hmph![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_01
text: You did well to come this far![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_15
text: I am Brassius—an artist specializing in Grass-type\nPokémon. I am also the Gym Leader here at the\r\nArtazon Gym.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_02
text: I was observing your Gym Test from atop the\nwindmill, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_03
text: The perception you displayed in finding Sunflora\nwas truly... Oh, how shall I describe it?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_04
text: Yes! It was truly avant-garde![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_05
text: I only pray that you might demonstrate that eye\nfor beauty in our battle as well.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_06
text: Enough talk! We must begin creating our\ncollaborative work of art![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_07
text: I trust that you are ready? It is time for our\nmasterpiece to take shape![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kari_01
text: [EMPTY 27]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_08
text: Oh! What artistic tactics you employ![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_09
text: The patterns of your moves! The minute details\nof your Pokémon’s performance! Everything you\r\ndid was honed to perfection![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_10
text: Our battle was, in a word, art! Indeed, if we\ncould not call that a work of artistry, then nothing\r\nelse in this world could be labeled as such![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_11
text: If I were to judge your work, I would say it passes\nmy inspection. Yes—a pass without exception![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_12
text: As proof of your artistic prowess, you may have\nmy Gym Badge! Shall we take a photo as well?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_badge
text: If you possess [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, it will be easier\nto catch Pokémon of up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)], and those\r\nPokémon should follow your commands as well![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_badge_all
text: If you possess 8 Gym Badges, you will be able\nto catch Pokémon of any level. And they will\r\nmost certainly obey your every command as well![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_waza
text: To a fantastic Trainer such as yourself, I would\nalso like to offer this—a favorite of mine![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_13
text: Ah! My inspiration is overflowing, as if drawn\nfrom a bottomless well![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_kusa_14
text: I will begin on a new piece at once! You must\nexcuse me. Farewell![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

label: gym_kusa_040_receptionist_04
text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nArtazon Gym!
